arguments.command:
python3 -c "
import parse, re
# Simpler test
format_str = 'fixed-point: {:f}'
p = parse.compile(format_str)
print('_expression:', repr(p._expression))
text = 'fixed-point: 100.2345'
match = re.match(p._expression, text)
if match:
    print('Match succeeded')
    print('Groups:', match.groups())
else:
    print('No match')
" 2>/dev/null
